description: Retrieve media attached to the event itself rather than to its teams, such as event YouTube videos and photo galleries. Returns media records with type, foreign_key, view URL, and direct URL. For media belonging to the event's teams see get_event_team_media.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.

name: get_event_media
title: Get Event Media
